change_definition.current_behavior: New TIED clients receive Grammar-Version v2 headers only; constraint language is Complete but opt-in; clients may remain legacy-v1 or header-only-v2; cohort tests forbid conflating header audit with constraint_flow or fleet-migrated proof.
change_definition.desired_behavior: Persisted fleet orchestrator REQ and governance ARCH document phased migration states, OD-1..OD-8 decisions, frozen client-inventory-manifest.v1 and migration-waiver.v1 schemas, gate promotion stages G0–G4, and LEAP-linked extension of REQ-PSEUDOCODE_GRAMMAR_V2_DEFAULT without Phase 1 sidecar migration or blocking CI.
change_definition.unchanged_behavior: v1 parser compatibility; REQ-PSEUDOCODE_CONSTRAINT_LANGUAGE analyzer semantics unless later amended; Tracks A/C/B shipped artifacts; Implemented bootstrap behavior for GRAMMAR_V2_DEFAULT until Phase 5.
non_goals: Per-client wave assignments or final pilot list
success_criteria: CITDP and Tracker reference integrated depth and advisory gate_policy
Pre-implementation gate allowed with inquiry artifacts or documented policy-only waiver path
Schema paths under working/fleet-constraint-v2/ referenced from ARCH
No satisfaction criterion equates grammar_v2_header with fleet-migrated-client
falsification_questions: Can a client claim fleet-migrated-client on grammar_v2_header pass alone?
Can constraint_flow pass with truncation treated as success once enforcement is on?
Does Phase 1 CITDP imply migration CLI or sidecar edits without a scoped REQ?

proof_boundaries: Phase 1 persist proves policy and schema contract documentation only, not fleet migration completeness or runtime behavior.

impact_analysis.impl_inventory_notes: Policy-only Phase 1; no IMPL-PSEUDOCODE_FLEET_MIGRATION_ORCHESTRATION unless executable orchestration is scoped later.

modules_or_boundaries.policy_module: Migration states, waivers, gate promotion, and supersession prose

modules_or_boundaries.orchestrator_module: stdd REQ/ARCH/CITDP; client-owned REQ-*-MIGRATION deferred to Phase 3+
